description: Checks a StatuteWire receipt JSON (the whole file text or object): hash, canonical form, Ed25519 signature against StatuteWire's published key, and roster totals. Free, not metered. VALID means the file is exactly as StatuteWire signed it; it does not say whether the practitioner is clean. A receipt signed with the SAMPLE key is reported as SAMPLE, not as valid. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

receipt.description: The receipt JSON file contents, as a string or an object.

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify a signed receipt
